observation.visible_scene: A close, eye-level shot of a two-compartment (yin-yang) metal hot pot filled with dark broth and assorted ingredients—shiitake, oyster and enoki mushrooms, bean sprouts, and green leafy vegetables. In the background sit a white cup on the left, a white plate on the right, and a person in pink and black clothing. A bamboo skewer threaded with puffed fried-tofu pieces and a red-and-white crab stick is held above the left compartment. Wisps of steam rise from the simmering broth.
visible_changes: The skewer with the fried-tofu and crab-stick pieces moves downward from the top edge of the frame into the left compartment, descending roughly through the first ~10 sampled frames and then remaining held at the rim/just inside the broth for the rest of the excerpt.
Steam becomes more visible and drifts upward over the left compartment as the segment progresses.
The pot, its contents, and the background objects stay in fixed positions; the camera shows no clear pan or zoom, indicating the skewer's descent is object motion rather than camera motion.
outside_clip_unknowns: Who holds the skewer and how it is manipulated.
Whether the skewered items are ultimately submerged to cook or lifted out.
The state of the pot before the segment began and the result after it ends.
uncertain_details: Exact depth of the skewered items—whether they rest on the rim or dip into the broth—cannot be confirmed.
Fine broth surface motion (bubbling vs. stillness) is not clearly resolvable between frames.
Minor apparent shifts in steam and lighting may be camera/encoding noise rather than physical change.
